title: Winey Tender Turkish Jerusalem Artichokes Kebabs
description: A keto-friendly Turkish-inspired solo dinner featuring tender and winey Jerusalem artichokes.
instructions: Peel the Jerusalem artichokes and cut them into 1-inch wedges.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, minced garlic, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the Jerusalem artichoke wedges to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated Jerusalem artichokes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and grill or broil over medium-high heat for 5-7 minutes per side, or until the artichokes are tender and slightly charred.
While the artichokes are cooking, heat the diced shio-cured salmon in a small pan over medium heat, stirring occasionally.
Remove the skewers from the heat and sprinkle with thyme and rosemary.
To serve, place the skewers on a plate and spoon the diced salmon over the top, then drizzle with red wine vinegar.
Garnish with fresh herbs and serve immediately
